Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 7. DD should be made in favour of PFA/NER/GKP payable at Gorakhpur . Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of PFA/NER/GKP A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 9. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1- The tenderer shall, In their offer, submit a performance certificate for at least 80% (i.e., 1 nos.) of the to tal supplied in the last three years. 2- Bidders must attach a valid Bid-Specific authorisation from the OEM if the firm is not the OEM or if the fir m's credentials are not verified by the OEM on the GeM platform. Without this, the offer shall be treated as unresponsive and ignored. 3- Bidders must attach a Declaration from the OEM regarding local content in compliance with the Public P rocurement (Preference to Make In India) Order 2017 if it is not declared on the product page of the offered product. Without this, the offer shall be treated as unresponsive and ignored. 4- Bidders should note that the techno-commercial evaluation will be based on the documents uploaded b y the bidder. No additional documents will be considered at the representation stage, except for historical documents, in compliance with Para 7.3.5 of the Manual for Procurement of Goods & Services. 5- The bidder must deposit the EMD/PBG in the beneficiary's name: PFA/NER/GKP, and send it to the followi ng office address in compliance with the bid requirements regarding EMD: Office of the Deputy Chief Mater ial Manager, General Stores Depot, Gorakhpur - 273012. 6- It is the bidder's responsibility to submit the required documents correctly under the respective tabs pro vided in the GeM bid. Bidders are advised to strictly adhere to this requirement for the techno-commercial evaluation.

7- Bidders must note that the Additional Specification Parameter will take precedence over the Technical S pecification. 8- Full specification & Term condition of Item- Attached in Buyer added bid specific ATC Para-11. Further Bi dder have to note the attached specification & Term condition of Buyer added Bid specific ATC will take pr ecedence over technical specification & Term condition. 9- In the event of failure by the firm to supply the goods after acceptance of the contract, or inability to fulf ill the supply within the stipulated terms and conditions, the Railway reserves the right to impose incident action, including forfeiture of the Security Deposit (SD). In cases where the firm has not submitted the Sec urity Deposit, the Purchase Order (PO) shall be cancelled with FR which is equivalent to the value of the Se curity Deposit i.e. 5% of PO value. 10- In place of inspection by RITES, it should be read that Stage-wise inspection shall be carried out by the MWS/GKP authorized representative as per Annexure-A, serial number 14 attached in buyer added bid spe cific ATC Para-11. 11- Bidders submitting their offer must give Para-wise remarks on each clause/sub clause (es) of attached specification in buyer added bid specific ATC Para-11 along with offer, failing which, the offer shall be liabl e to be rejected. . 11.
